Name: Harvey Hungarian Wedding Outfit
Author: Elaho
TagLine:
Changes Harvey's wedding sprite to incorporate traditional Hungarian wedding regalia.
Now with seasonal variations!
Description:
**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod.**

This mod changes Harvey's original wedding outfit to incorporate a fusion of modern-traditional Hungarian wedding regalia, and includes:

- Black __jodhpur__ or white __gatya__ style trousers (depending on the season)
- Tight-fitting boots
- Linen shirt with black embroidered belt
__- Dolmany__ waistcoat or __Bocskai__ jacket (depending on the season)
- Black felt hat (depending on the season)

The Hungarian people are known for being friendly, polite, and open-minded, but also a little reserved when just getting to know them. However, deep beneath the surface, they are extremely dedicated and devoted to the people and things they care about. When first meeting Harvey, he comes across as being rather timid, shy, and reserved (if not a little boring); however, after getting to know him, he is a deeply passionate, loyal, and devoted person with big dreams and an even bigger heart.

Being the devoted and proud person we come to know him to be, I think Harvey would want to celebrate his Hungarian heritage on his special day with your farmer.

__Gratulálok és a legjobbakat kívánom mindkettőtöknek az esküvőtök napján!__

-----------------------------
*PLEASE NOTE:

**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. No action needed.**

This mod will NOT work with other wedding outfit mods that include Harvey. If you want this mod to be compatible with other sprite editing mods, you'll need to either delete Harvey's wedding version in those mods or only have this one installed. Having two different mods that change Harvey's wedding appearance will not work together and may cause the game to crash.*
